text: Here's a quick tour of prayer campaigns in the with orgs plan option. Creating a campaign, managing its landing page and content, and looking after the people who pray.

Two ideas hold it together. A site is the long-lived home, with its own address, team, look, and people. A campaign is one run of that site, with dates, content, and a goal. There are no campaign types. A campaign is just four answers: its start, its end, its goal, and how often new content arrives.
First, creating a campaign.
Everything starts from Your sites. New site opens a short onboarding that explains sites and campaigns before asking for anything.
Describe the site. The address is suggested from the name, and the location puts its prayers on the map.
Then pick a template. Ramadan fills in the answers: a shared start date, about thirty days, daily content, and the people-mobilized goal. Every answer stays editable.
Choose the languages the site runs in. Here, English, Turkish, and Arabic.
Prayer content comes from a library. The template suggests one: use it as is, adapt it, or write your own.
Add a top image and a reply-to address, and check the launch checklist. Then publish. The site is live.
And this is the public page, built from those answers: goal progress, signup, today's prayer, and sharing.
Next, managing the landing page and content.
The landing page has fixed sections in a fixed order, and empty ones hide themselves. Add your own sections, and translate what you write with AI translate.
Save, and the new section is on the live site.
Prayer content is a numbered sequence of days. Step through days and languages, edit in a rich text editor, and placeholders like place fill in for each site.
Each campaign keeps its own setup, a thank you email for when it ends, and its results. Next year, relaunch on the same site.
Finally, managing subscribers.
People sign up by choosing when to be reminded, in their own language and time zone. The boxes for updates are separate, and never pre-ticked.
Every signup lands in the site's CRM as an intercessor.
Open one to see their prayer times and next reminder. Pause or add times, send a check-in, or delete their data on request.
Site email reaches only people who opted in on this site: the current campaign, past campaigns, or everyone who asked for updates. Prayer reminders are never affected.
Stats track progress toward the goal, and owners can export intercessors at any time.
Create, manage, and grow, all from one site. Take a look, and share your feedback on this plan option.
